system.description: At conflict start, spend 10 HP: cast a spell of (10 × SL) total cost or less as a runic spell, paid upfront, and name a trigger. The first time it is met the spell must release, free — targets chosen then. Still held at scene's end: lost, and you recover 5 HP.
